handoff.objective: TWO jobs. (A) ATTACK THE IDENTICAL-DISTRIBUTION ASSUMPTION on which BATCH-015 rests. The occupancy floor mean_T(1 - mu_T/N) = 0.9183 dissolves ANOM-5, and it is EXACT under i.i.d. iterations -- but it is FALSE without identical distribution: a counterexample of floor(mu) deterministic iterations plus one Bernoulli(frac) returns phi = 0.00433, some 2300 sd below it. The file header supports identical distribution and the pooled-rate estimator already assumes it, but the archive contains NO per-iteration data with which to verify it. Build the strongest case that the assumption fails for this data, and name the cheapest check that would settle it. If it survives, say so and state exactly what the floor is then entitled to claim. (B) RULE EXPLICITLY ON EXHAUSTION. Resolving the remaining -1.5 sd mid-band residue to 3 sd would need roughly 1321 to 1488 bins and this archive has 301. State whether the mid-band lane is EXHAUSTED at this archive resolution. If it is, say so plainly with a named obstruction and forward guidance per the inventor-protocol closure standard; declaring a lane exhausted when it is is a RESULT, not a failure -- and declaring it exhausted when it is not is the premature-closure failure mode the same protocol treats as equal to overclaiming.
